parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by ‘schizophrenia’.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe the genetic explanation of schizophrenia, as outlined by Gottesman and Shields
(1972).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain one similarity and one difference between cognitive and genetic explanations of
schizophrenia.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the treatment and management of depression.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate the treatment and management of depression, including a discussion of ethics. 
Psychology and consumer behaviour

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by the term ‘choice heuristics’ in consumer decision-making.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Outline two aims of the study by Wansink et al. (1998) on consumer decision-making.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain the validity of the study by Wansink et al. (1998).

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe what psychologists have discovered about communication and advertising models.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about communication and advertising models,
including a discussion about applications to everyday life. 
Psychology and health

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Explain what is meant by ‘self-reports’ as a subjective measure of non-adherence to medical
advice.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: From the health belief model by Becker and Rosenstock (1974):

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: State two beliefs of this model.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Explain how one of these beliefs applies to non-adherence to medical advice.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain one strength and one weakness of the health belief model, as applied to
non-adherence to medical advice.

parts.text:

campaign to avoid chip pan fires.
